subject: Air freight quote to SGN
body:
Hi,

Could you quote your cheapest air freight option to SGN (Ho Chi Minh City, VN), all-in in EUR? Please include truck pickup from our warehouse to the airport. The goods are ready for pickup on 2026-11-29.

Shipment: 3 pieces of textile samples, 874 kg gross, 2.77 cbm.

Sara
Lindqvist Medtech
